entities.name: San Ciriaco alle Terme di Diocleziano
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: San Ciriaco alle Terme Diocleziane was a church in the Baths of Diocletian in Rome. It was made a titulus by the Roman synod of 1 March 499.
